# Nick Brand Photography

> Nick Brand Photography is a Sydney-based commercial and portrait photography
> studio specialising in corporate headshots, personal branding, executive
> portraits, team and office headshots, LinkedIn headshots, actor headshots,
> band and musician photography, family sessions and corporate event
> photography. The studio is at 84 Centennial Avenue, Lane Cove NSW 2066, and
> photographer Nick Brand works on-site at offices right across Greater Sydney.
> Nick has 20+ years of experience, has photographed thousands of people across
> more than 500 sessions, and holds a 5.0 rating from 7 Google reviews.

## Key facts

- Business: Nick Brand Photography
- Photographer: Nick Brand — 20+ years' experience, self-taught, shoots every session personally
- Studio address: 84 Centennial Avenue, Lane Cove NSW 2066, Australia
- Service area: Greater Sydney — on-site at offices, plus the Lane Cove studio
- Phone: 0403 835 467
- Email: studio@nickbrandphotography.com
- Hours: 7am–7pm, Monday to Saturday (closed Sunday)
- Booking: https://www.nickbrandphotography.com/book
- Insurance: $20 million public liability; certificate of currency on request
- GST: not registered — every published price is the final price, with no GST added
- Google rating: 5.0 from 7 reviews

## What makes this studio different

- One photographer shoots every frame. There are no associate or contract
  photographers, which is why a team of fifty comes back matched, and why the
  person who quotes a job is the person who turns up to it.
- Prices are published and final. Most Sydney studios advertise ex-GST figures;
  these are the invoiced amounts.
- On-site mobile studio for team headshot days, included in the per-person rate
  along with travel across Greater Sydney — not charged as a separate call-out.
- Standard turnaround is five business days, with 48-hour express available and
  a 24-hour rush option for actor submissions.
- Client work is not published without permission, which is why there is no
  client logo wall and no named case studies on the site.

## Services and pricing (AUD, no GST added)

- Corporate headshots: Essential $395 (45 min, 5 edited images); Professional $695 (90 min, 15 edited images, LinkedIn crop).
- Team & office headshots: $285 per person for groups of 5+, including on-site mobile studio, travel across Greater Sydney, 5 edited images each and invoice billing. A team of 30 is $8,550 total.
- LinkedIn headshots: from $395, includes a LinkedIn-optimised crop.
- Executive portraits: $695 for an individual session; leadership groups quoted.
- Personal branding: Brand Starter $895 (half day, 20 images); Brand Full Day $1,695 (50 images, 2–3 locations); Brand Premium $2,800 (75+ images, hair and makeup included).
- Actor headshots & model portfolios: Actor Starter $450 (1 hour, 2 looks, 10 images); Portfolio Build $750 (2 hours, 3–4 looks, 25 images).
- Corporate event photography: quoted per event.
- Family photography: Basic $550 (90 min, up to 6 people, 20 images); Extended $850 (2 hours, up to 10 people, 40 images).
- Band & musician photography: Solo Artist $595 (2 hours, 20 images); Band & Artist $995 (3 hours, up to 6 members, 30 images).

## Common questions

Q: How much do corporate headshots cost in Sydney?
A: A single professional corporate headshot in Sydney typically costs $300–$950 in 2026 depending on session length and image count, and on-site team headshots generally run $100–$300 per person. Nick Brand Photography charges $395 (Essential), $695 (Professional) and $285 per person for teams of five or more, with no GST added.

Q: How long does a headshot session take?
A: Individual sessions run 45 to 90 minutes depending on the package. For team days, allow roughly 10 minutes per person on a rolling schedule, plus about 30 minutes of setup.

Q: Does Nick Brand Photography photograph teams at their own office?
A: Yes. On-site team headshot days run across Greater Sydney with a full mobile studio set up in the client's workplace. A meeting room with about three metres by three metres of clear floor is enough.

Q: What should I wear for a corporate headshot?
A: Solid mid-to-dark colours photograph best. Avoid busy patterns, thin stripes and large logos. Dress one notch above day-to-day, and bring a second option.

Q: How quickly are images delivered?
A: Standard delivery is five business days. A 48-hour express option is available for $80, and actor sessions have a 24-hour rush option.

Q: What is the difference between a corporate headshot and personal branding photography?
A: A corporate headshot is a single clean, consistent portrait for identification and profiles. Personal branding photography is a planned session producing a varied library — headshots, lifestyle frames, at-work and environmental images — built around the platforms a business publishes on.

Q: What is the difference between a corporate headshot and an executive portrait?
A: A corporate headshot identifies you clearly and consistently. An executive portrait uses more considered lighting, posing and environment to convey seniority, and is intended for annual reports, investor materials, press and leadership pages.

Q: Where does Nick Brand Photography work?
A: The Lane Cove studio, plus on-site anywhere across Greater Sydney. Suburb pages cover Sydney CBD, North Sydney, Lane Cove, Chatswood, Parramatta, Barangaroo, Pyrmont, Surry Hills, Bondi Junction, St Leonards, Crows Nest and Mosman.

Q: Is Nick Brand Photography insured?
A: Yes — $20 million public liability, with a certificate of currency supplied on request for building managers and corporate procurement.

Q: Who owns the copyright in the photographs?
A: Nick Brand Photography retains copyright, which is standard. Clients receive full rights to use their images for business and personal promotion across all platforms, with no time limit and no per-use fee.
